description: This file defines the Header class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for generating the data used in rendering the header section of the website. It gathers various configuration, language, user, and session data to pass to a view template.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing header data for rendering on the website, including site info, user session, and navigation links.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Collects site, user, session, and configuration data to generate an array of variables used in the header view template.
